content: Original curator paraphrase: cTrader describes ATR as a moving average of true range over a declared period, with a simple 14-period average as its documented default. The lab feature variant uses the arithmetic mean of the latest 14 completed true ranges, each the maximum of high-minus-low, absolute high-minus-previous-close and absolute low-minus-previous-close. It is not Wilder recursive smoothing. ATR describes volatility, not direction, expected profit or confirmation of this spread gate.
